en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A patient cannot be healed like (he can) with the likes of honey’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “
A patient does not receive a cure as he can with honey.’”
